title: Overcoming the Intermediate Plateau: A Practical Roadmap for B1–B2 Learners
dek: Discover actionable strategies, mindsets, and deliberate practice routines to break out of the comfortable intermediate plateau and reach effortless B2–C1 fluency.

blocks.say: The intermediate plateau occurs when initial rapid progress slows down because you can already handle daily interactions. To advance, you need deliberate practice.

blocks.text: At B1, passive understanding outpaces active output. The solution lies in shifting from passive consumption to deliberate practice: active recall, vocabulary upgrades, and challenging speaking contexts.
blocks.say: Shifting from passive consumption to deliberate practice transforms your spoken fluency.
Three core principles: upgrade safe phrases, embrace error reflection, and engage in real-time discussions.

blocks.targetText: Instead of defaulting to 'I agree', practice 'I couldn't agree more' or 'I see it differently'.
blocks.gloss: Replacing safe default phrases with expressive upgrades.
blocks.say: Instead of defaulting to 'I agree', practice 'I couldn't agree more' or 'I see it differently'.

blocks.title: The Comfort Zone Fallacy
blocks.content: In language acquisition research, comfort is the enemy of growth. Pushing into topics where you lack vocabulary forces your brain to build new neural pathways.
blocks.say: Culture bite: Pushing beyond your comfort zone builds new language pathways.
Test your understanding with a quick 3-question mini-quiz.

blocks.question: What primary shift is needed to overcome the intermediate plateau?
options: From passive consumption to deliberate active output.
blocks.explanation: Active deliberate practice transforms passive knowledge into spoken fluency.
